tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per the bid documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PERFORMANCE CONTRACT STATEMENT & EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE With WORK ORDERS:-The Agency should have Experience of provided man power to maintenance of Cleaning & Sanitation Services at Government Hospitals/Quasi Government Hospitals/Government Autonomous Medical Institutions/ Any Government Institutions/Private Medical Colleges & Hospitals/Corporate Sectors and should have provided minimum 130 Labours per year for last 02 financial years of 2023-24 and 2024-25 the details as per the Performance Contracts Statement as per the ANNEXURE-III along with EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATES as per ANNEXURE-IV or its equivalent or as per the Principal Employers Format that consisting of required information and its related WORK ORDERS should be uploaded in original/self attested.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PERFORMANCE CONTRACT STATEMENT & EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE With WORK ORDERS

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN CARD:-The Agency or Tenderer should have PAN CARD and should be uploaded in original/self attested.
GST REG 06 CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should have GST REG-06 registration certificate and should be uploaded in original /self attested.

EPF REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should have valid EPF registration certificate issued by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner as per EPF Act and should be uploaded in original.

ESI REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should have valid ESI registration certificate issued by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner a s per ESI Act and should be uploaded in original.

PROFESSIONAL TAX REGISTRATION FORM No.3 CERTIFICATE:- The Agency must have Certificate of Enrolment issued under Karnataka Tax on Professions, Traders, Calling and Employment Act1976 (Form-3) should be uploaded in original.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PROFESSIONAL TAX REGISTRATION FORM No.3 CERTIFICATE

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST RETURNS STATEMENT:- GSTR Returns Statement as per Annexure-IX for the last Two Financial years 2023-24 and 2024-25 certified by the Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number in original and last Six Months GST returns copies should be uploaded.

EPF REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should submit the EPF Remittance Statement Annexure-X minimum for Rs.39.00 Lakhs per Annum for having remitted for the Financial year 2023-24 and 2024-25 duly certified by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner and Last 06 Months EPF Challans as per EPF Act should be uploaded in original.

ESI REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should submit the ESI Remittance Statement Annexure-XI minimum for Rs.10.00 Lakhs per Annum for having remitted for the Financial year 2023-24 and 2024-25 duly certified by the Office of Sub-Regional and Last 06 Months ESI Challans should be uploaded in original.

PROFESSIONAL TAX CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should submit the Professional Tax clearance certificate as on 31/03/2025 issued by the Commissioner of Commercial Tax Department should be uploaded in original.

ANNUAL TURNOVER CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should submit the Annual Turnover for the last Two financial years i.e. 2023-24 and 2024-25 for having minimum Rs.404/-Lakhs -turnover per any one year per ANNEXURE-VIII provided Man power to maintenance of Cleaning & Sanitation issued & certified by the Chartered Accountant along with UDIN Number should be uploaded in Original.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ITR RETURNS:-Income Tax Returns ITR for the last Two Financial years with trading, P & L Balance Sheet 2023-24 and 2024-25 in original should be uploaded duly certified by the -Chartered Accountant.
EMD: The Tenderer should remit Earnest Money in the e-portal and Receipt is to be uploaded in original with seal & Signature
QUALITY CONTROL CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should have valid ISO9001:2015 Quality Control Certificate for Man Power Services and should be uploaded in original.
SELF DECLARATION :-The Agency shall give Self Declaration in Rs.500/- Stamp Paper attested by the Government Notary as per the ANNEXURE-II.
TENDER OFFER FORM :- The Tender Offer Form as per the ANNEXURE--VII should be uploaded in original
Office Address:- The Tenderer Should be have the office at Ballari city limit.
